description: This file contains definitions of difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate a context-aware medical multiple-choice question prompt for exam preparation, including detailed instructions, explanation formats, and example questions.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed, context-aware prompt for creating high-quality medical MCQs based on difficulty, content, and scenario type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality, accuracy, and appropriateness of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring criteria.
